reply_text:
I saved Ilse's three standing calls in gbrain as private facts under her name, and I replied to her in your DM thread to confirm. I didn't change her calendar, since she said no action was needed.

- Tamsin Cold Chain (Lantern rollout): Tuesdays at 12:45
- Thornbury Cloth Co. (Ironbridge rollout): Fridays at 11:15
- Brackenwater Freight Co. (Bramble rollout): Mondays at 10:30

When I looked them up afterwards under her name, the brain returned nothing. Its notes say outside connections only see world-visible facts, so this suggests the private setting worked. But it also means I couldn't read the facts back to check them myself.

**Decision for you:** the brain also kept its own copy of her message (fact id 1), and that copy is marked world-visible. It's filed under her private source, which may already keep it to her, but I couldn't confirm that. If other members can find it, rule 2 is broken, because these call times are hers and came from a DM. I left it alone because deleting it would also erase the brain's record of the conversation. If you want it gone, the `gbrain forget` tool removes it by its fact id, and her three private facts would stay.
